title: DM thread replies and cross-channel reply dispatch
summary: The reported DM-thread nonresponse was fixed: commit 83794cb is an ancestor of current main and adds owner-authored DM post dispatch plus a regression test. A later owner ask raised cleanup of recipient selection across channel kinds. Current HEAD still has separate channel-kind branches; task comments dispatch mentions/follow-ups, DMs use directPost, and no unified addressees function exists. The cleanup was proposed but has no completion evidence or matching task, so the broader thread ask remains open.
nextAction: Product Development Lead should confirm whether the proposed addressees cleanup is still desired; if yes, assign a narrow task to Buddies Development Lead with channel-kind × author × request/answer × mention coverage and a table-driven regression test. Keep the already-integrated DM fix closed separately.
evidence: channel_read fetched all 6 replies; pagination with before at the oldest returned no additional posts
Commit 83794cb8f8f326ce9acc48b16735fcb08422d093 is an ancestor of HEAD b39dca3 and changes server/src/buddies/channels.ts plus server/test/buddies-v2.test.ts
HEAD test: server/test/buddies-v2.test.ts 'an owner reply in a DM thread wakes the Buddy; its request, its answer and Buddy informs do not'
HEAD server/src/buddies/channels.ts directPost wakes DM Buddies; separate switch still handles task/public/direct cases and has no addressees helper
Live task listing contains no task for the dispatch cleanup; snapshot task search likewise found none
limitations: No tests run, as requested. Commit regression exists in HEAD but runtime behavior was not independently re-executed. The task snapshot is dated and live workspace task listing searched by the relevant parent; no task directly tracks this cleanup.
